title: Lid-driven cavity, Re = 100
claim: A converged steady solution of the 2D incompressible Navier-Stokes equations in a unit square cavity with a lid moving at speed 1 reproduces the Ghia et al. (1982) centreline velocity profiles at Re = 100.
equations: Projection: u* = u^n + dt(-(u.grad)u + nu lap u);  lap p = div(u*)/dt;  u^(n+1) = u* - dt grad p
method: cavity-mac (Chorin projection, staggered grid, central differences, explicit Euler, SOR pressure solve)

acceptance.tolerance_source: LAB-CHOSEN, set before the first run. The paper states no tolerance for this comparison.

open_items: Reference values are not checked against the PDF (see data/ghia1982_re100.json).
Page and table numbers for the reference data are unconfirmed.
The paper uses a vorticity/stream-function multigrid solver on a 129x129 grid. This lab uses a different formulation and grid, so differences include discretisation error.
The paper does not state a steady-state criterion for Re = 100 that matches this lab's.
Tolerance of 0.02 is a lab choice, not from the paper.
